# SlowedLab

> SlowedLab is a free, private browser audio studio for changing playback
> speed, adding reverb, shaping tone with EQ, compression and distortion, and
> exporting a finished WAV. Audio is processed on the visitor's own device —
> files are never uploaded to a server.

## What it does

- Variable-speed playback with pitch preservation (slowed / sped up)
- Reverb plus EQ, compression and distortion
- Waveform visualization with click-to-seek
- Presets, including custom ones
- Import by link (YouTube, SoundCloud) or local file upload
- Export to WAV
- Works with MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, AAC and more, up to 200 MB

## Key facts

- URL: https://slowedlab.app
- Pricing: free, no account required
- License: MIT
- Privacy: audio processing happens in the browser, not on a server
- Requirements: a modern browser with Web Audio API support
